verses.text: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያና ሐዋርያ ከሆነው ከስምዖን ጴጥሮስ፥ በአምላካችንና በመድኃኒታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጽድቅ ካገኘነው ጋር የተካከለ የክብር እምነትን ላገኙ፤

sections.title: The Calling and Choosing of Christians

verses.text: The power of the heavens, in its own glory and in its goodness, has called us to know that all things necessary for life and to glorify God have been given to us. May grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of our Lord Jesus.

Therefore, concerning the evil desire that exists in the world, I beseech you to be partakers of the heavenly calling, that you may be found in those who are honored and good, for we have been given a great hope that is exceedingly glorious.
For this reason, showing all diligence, add to your faith virtue.
And in virtue, knowledge; and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
And in godliness, brotherly kindness; and in brotherly kindness, love.
If these things abound in you, they will make you neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For he who lacks these things is short-sighted, even to blindness, and has forgotten that he was cleansed from his old sins.
Therefore, brethren, be even more diligent to make your calling and election sure, for if you do these things, you will never stumble.
For so an entrance will be supplied to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
For this reason, I will not be negligent to remind you always of these things, though you know and are established in the present truth.
Always, while I am in this body, it seems fitting to me to stir you up by way of reminder.
Our Lord Jesus Christ, as He has regarded me, I know that I shall be hastened to depart from this body.
After my departure, I have made it my aim that you may be able to remember these things at all times.

sections.title: Concerning the glory of Christ and the word of prophecy.

verses.text: Do not behold His glory, but rather let it be known to you that the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ was revealed to us through the word that was created in wisdom.
From the glory of the Lord, the voice that says, "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased," has been received with honor and praise from God the Father.
And we, while we are with Him on the holy mountain, heard this voice when it came down from heaven.

Moreover, we have a more sure word of prophecy; until the earth shall pass away, and until the evening star shall rise in your hearts, this word shall shine in the darkness, as a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts.
Know this first of all: no prophecy of Scripture is a matter of one's own interpretation.
For prophecy never came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

Yet, there were false prophets among the people; and likewise, there shall be false teachers among you; they shall bring upon themselves swift destruction, even as they deny the Lord that bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
Many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you; whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked: for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;

The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished; but chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government.
Presumptuous are they, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities, whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption.

They shall receive the dew of their transgressions. In the day they are refreshed, they shall be counted as the dead; the wicked and the vile, when they gather with you, shall be refreshed in love's banquet;
There are eyes that are filled with sin and do not see; they shall not spare the souls that do not cry out; they have hearts that do not desire; they are forsaken.
They have forsaken the righteous way and have followed the path of the son of man; he has gone to the dew of transgressions.
But concerning their transgression, they have become desolate; the mute beast spoke in the voice of man and destroyed the prophet's foolishness.
The deep darkness that has been reserved for eternity, these are the waters that have no sources; they are clouds that have risen with the mighty wind.
They speak of a great word rather than vanity and excess; even in their errors, they shall be filled with the desires of the flesh.
They themselves have become servants of destruction, saying, "You shall be set free;" thus they give hope to their own; for a man is a servant to the one who has been ensnared.
In our Lord and our Savior, Jesus Christ, after they have turned from the world's wickedness, they shall be cast away again, and if they are ensnared, they are worse than before.
Their knowledge, when given to them, shall return to the holy command, for they have not known the way of righteousness; they were better off in their ignorance.
"The dog returns to its vomit," and likewise, "The washed sow returns to wallowing in the mire," as the truth says; these are examples for the faithful.

sections.title: The hope of the Lord's coming.

verses.text: ወዳጆች ሆይ! አሁን የምጽፍላችሁ መልእክት ይህች ሁለተኛይቱ ናት። በቅዱሳን ነቢያትም ቀድሞ የተባለውን ቃል በሐዋርያቶቻችሁም ያገኛችኋትን የጌታችንንና የመድኃኒታችንን ትእዛዝ እንድታስቡ በሁለቱ እያሳሰብኋችሁ ቅን ልቡናችሁን አነቃቃለሁ።
በመጨረሻው ዘመን እንደ ራሳቸው ምኞት የሚመላለሱ ዘባቾች በመዘበት እንዲመጡ ይህን በፊት እወቁ፤
እነርሱም “የመምጣቱ የተስፋ ቃል ወዴት ነው? አባቶች ከሞቱባት ጊዜ ከፍጥረት መጀመሪያ ይዞ ሁሉ እንዳለ ይኖራልና፤” ይላሉ።
ሰማያት ከጥንት ጀምረው ምድርም በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከውሃ ተጋጥማ በውሃ መካከል እንደ ነበሩ ወደው አያስተውሉምና፤
በዚህም ምክንያት ያን ጊዜ የነበረ ዓለም በውሃ ሰጥሞ ጠፋ፤
አሁን ያሉ ሰማያትና ምድር ግን እግዚአብሔርን የማያመልኩት ሰዎች እስከሚጠፉበት እስከ ፍርድ ቀን ድረስ ተጠብቀው በዚያ ቃል ለእሳት ቀርተዋል።
እናንተ ግን ወዳጆች ሆይ! በጌታ ዘንድ አንድ ቀን እንደ ሺህ ዓመት፥ ሺህ ዓመትም እንደ አንድ ቀን እንደ ሆነ ይህን አንድ ነገር አትርሱ።
ለአንዳንዶች የሚዘገይ እንደሚመስላቸው ጌታ ስለ ተስፋ ቃሉ አይዘገይም፤ ነገር ግን ሁሉ ወደ ንስሓ እንዲደርሱ እንጂ ማንም እንዳይጠፋ ወዶ ስለ እናንተ ይታገሣል።
የጌታው ቀን ግን እንደ ሌባ ሆኖ ይመጣል፤ በዚያም ቀን ሰማያት በታላቅ ድምፅ ያልፋሉ፤ የሰማይም ፍጥረት በትልቅ ትኵሳት ይቀልጣል፤ ምድርም በእርስዋም ላይ የተደረገው ሁሉ ይቃጠላል።
ይህ ሁሉ እንዲህ የሚቀልጥ ከሆነ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቀን መምጣት እየጠበቃችሁና እያስቸኰላችሁ በቅዱስ ኑሮ እግዚአብሔርንም በመምሰል እንደ ምን ልትሆኑ ይገባችኋል? ስለዚያ ቀን ሰማያት ተቃጥለው ይቀልጣሉ፤ የሰማይም ፍጥረት በትልቅ ትኵሳት ይፈታል፤
Yet, we hold fast to the promise of a new heaven and a new earth, wherein righteousness dwelleth.
Therefore, beloved brethren! As you keep this in mind, be steadfast and unmovable, that you may dwell in peace with Him.
And let your faith in our Lord be your strength. Thus, our beloved brother Paul, as it has been given, has written to you with wisdom.

In all his epistles, he has likewise spoken on this matter. There is indeed a thing that is difficult to understand in them; those who are unlearned and unstable wrest them, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
Therefore, beloved brethren! Since you are forewarned, take heed, lest you fall from your own steadfastness, being led away with the error of the wicked.
But grow in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be glory both now and forever. Amen.
